world.summary: Climbing tall mountains like Kilimanjaro is a study in contrasts — from beating sun to freezing nights, fire and snow. Climbing tall mountains like Kilimanjaro is a study in contrasts. The beating sun bakes you during the day, walking so close to the equator, but the nights quickly dip below freezing. Snow remains constantly in sight from humid rainforest and alpine landscapes, freshly charred from a wildfire three weeks before.
